applicable_statutes.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance Just Cause & Universal Right to Counsel
applicable_statutes.citation: SF Admin. Code Ch. 37 & Prop F
applicable_statutes.summary: Requires enumerated just cause for residential eviction, caps annual rent adjustments on covered units, and guarantees city-funded legal representation within 30 days of unlawful detainer service.

applicable_statutes.title: California Implied Warranty of Habitability & Rent Demand Bar
applicable_statutes.summary: Bars landlords from demanding rent, increasing rent, or serving a 3-day pay-or-quit notice when an official building/housing citation for untenantable residential conditions (missing heat, hot water, weatherproofing, plumbing, or safe wiring) remains unabated past 35 days.

applicable_statutes.title: California Statutory Anti-Retaliation Protection
applicable_statutes.summary: Establishes a 180-day statutory bar against retaliatory eviction, rent hikes, or service reductions after a residential tenant complains to a municipal building inspection agency.

applicable_relief_funds.title: RadCo / Mission Economic Development Family Stabilization Grant
applicable_relief_funds.summary: Awards up to $7,500 in back-rent and PG&E utility shutoff prevention for low-income residential families <=60% AMI experiencing acute medical leave or wage loss.

applicable_relief_funds.title: San Francisco Emergency Rental Assistance Program (SF ERAP)
applicable_relief_funds.summary: Covers up to $12,000 across six months of residential rental arrears or move-in deposits for San Francisco renter households at or below 80% of Area Median Income (AMI), prioritizing families <=30% AMI.

applicable_relief_funds.title: Code Enforcement Relocation & Mold Remediation Bridge
applicable_relief_funds.summary: Provides temporary hotel/relocation stipends up to $8,500 exclusively for residential apartment tenants whose unit has an open un-abated DBI notice for no heat, raw sewage, or toxic mold.

applicable_relief_funds.title: Proposition F Tenant Right to Counsel & Habitability Defense
applicable_relief_funds.summary: Pairs full unlawful detainer legal representation with habitability rent-abatement motions and up to $6,000 in stipulation bridges for residential tenants with an active open Department of Building Inspection habitability complaint.
